name: Pactiv Evergreen - Canandaigua CTC Distribution Center NY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Street View (2016-09) at the shared campus south entrance ~42.9028,-77.3030: a black-and-white striped barrier arm spans the truck lane, flanked by two sliding chain-link gates and STOP signs, with perimeter chain-link fencing. The CTC Distribution Center (2480 Sommers Drive) sits on the same gated Pactiv campus as the Canandaigua plant and shares this single truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small flat-roof staffed booth (windowed multiple sides, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, 'Adecco' sign, US flag pole) sits immediately beside the gate lane — the staffed check-in booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a guard booth is present. A 'Pick Up Phone For Directions' call-box kiosk is a secondary aid only.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Internal paved access roads and aprons inside the gate give ample queue room before the DC dock banks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the shared gate to the DC dock faces (several hundred metres up the campus road).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-bay gate apron with room to add a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: DC warehouse buildings on the west campus show dock faces with trailers backed in along the long building faces; estimate ~35 doors across the DC buildings. Low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large marked trailer drop yards surround the DC buildings — well over 100 parked trailers in long rows; clearly 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: DC dock activity appears to run from common warehouse faces; no clearly separate dedicated ship vs. receive dock clusters identifiable from imagery — set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True — the DC is part of a multi-building Pactiv campus (manufacturing plant complex plus multiple warehouse/distribution buildings).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers ring the DC warehouses, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur enters the campus from the NE and curves down the east edge; the campus is rail-served (spur primarily reaches the plant side).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: North Street industrial corridor on the NW edge of Canandaigua, a small NY town; bordered by woods, fields and a retention pond. Edge-of-town / rural setting.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~180 trailers counted in the DC drop-yard rows; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Shared campus perimeter ~145 acres; the DC occupies the western portion.
